title: A60 Negative Evidence Register row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/canonical/core_controls/A60_negative_evidence_register.csv. Negative evidence captures what is explicitly NOT supported by the corpus — absence of expected statements, refutations, gaps that map back to claims. Used by bsa-skeptical-reviewer + bsa-no-new-claims-auditor to surface unsupported assertions.

NegEvID.description: Stable identifier. Two recognized prefixes: N-NNN (terse) or NE-NNN (longer 'negative evidence' marker). Both are valid; choose one and stay consistent within an engagement. Category-prefix variants accepted (N-INJ-001, NE-INJ-001).

SourceID.description: Foreign key into A50. May be empty for global negative findings (no specific source). Accepts category-prefixed IDs.

ExcerptRef.description: Optional locator reference. Free-form (may point to A58 ExcerptID, page number, or 'absent').

RelatedClaimID.description: Optional cross-reference into A59. When set, this negative evidence relates to a specific claim (e.g., contradiction or absence of expected support). Accepts category-prefixed IDs.

NegativeFinding.description: Description of what is absent or refuted. Required non-empty.

A51Ref.description: Optional cross-reference into A51 when the negative finding warrants tracking as an issue route.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for diff stability.
